descripcion: F9 · Carta con reduced motion: abrir y cerrar con fundido corto (sin caída ni giro), el flip es un fundido que igual deja el dorso a la vista, el barrido es un fundido a negro (sin desplazamiento).

steps.eval: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); const caida = document.querySelector('[data-carta-caida]'); const ys = []; await __waitUntil(() => { ys.push(Math.abs(__qa.gsap.getProperty(caida, 'y')) + Math.abs(__qa.gsap.getProperty(caida, 'rotation'))); return __estado(); }, (e) => e === 'abierta'); const dt = performance.now() - t0; return [location.pathname, dt < 700, Math.max(...ys)]; })()
steps.label: 1 abre en menos de 0,7 s y los cartelitos no caen ni giran (solo fundido)

steps.eval: (async () => { const f = document.querySelector('[data-carta-card=fuegos] [data-carta-flip]'); const rots = new Set(); await __waitUntil(() => { rots.add(Math.round(__qa.gsap.getProperty(f, 'rotationY'))); return [Math.round(__qa.gsap.getProperty(f, 'rotationY')), getComputedStyle(f).opacity]; }, (v) => v[0] === 180 && v[1] === '1', 3000); return [[...rots].every((r) => r === 0 || r === 180), Math.round(__qa.gsap.getProperty(f, 'rotationY'))]; })()
steps.label: 2 flip con fundido: pasa de 0° a 180° sin ángulos intermedios

steps.eval: (async () => { const b = document.querySelector('[data-barrido]'); const ys = []; await __waitUntil(() => { ys.push(Math.round(__qa.gsap.getProperty(b, 'yPercent'))); return location.pathname; }, (p) => p === '/carta/fuegos'); await __qa.cartaEstable(); return [location.pathname, Math.max(...ys.map(Math.abs)), b.dataset.barrido]; })()
steps.label: 3 barrido con reduced motion: fundido a negro, sin desplazamiento

steps.eval: (async () => { const t0 = performance.now(); await __waitUntil(__estado, (e) => e === 'cerrada'); return [location.pathname + location.hash, performance.now() - t0 < 700]; })()
steps.label: 4 Esc cierra en menos de 0,7 s
